releaseNotes:
### Ticketek Instant Mode — Restricted View highlight

• Categories explicitly labelled **Restricted View** now show an amber **Restricted view** badge, amber accent bar and subtle amber row highlight.

• If the category is also **Cheapest**, its green cheapest highlight remains, with both **Cheapest** and **Restricted view** badges visible together. The amber accent keeps the view warning recognizable.

• Applies in the on-page Instant Mode chooser and the extension's Instant Mode category lists. Original category names and prices are preserved.

• No new Side View badge or clear-view claims. This is a visual aid only: category availability, cheapest-price calculation, selection order, ticket requests and manual payment are unchanged.

Reload the extension and refresh the Ticketek tab before a new search, not during an active request, hold or payment.
